% Generated by paper/figures/src/gen_main_tables.py from results/; do not edit by hand.
% Shared style of the generated tables (paper v6). Each table snippet inputs this file once:
%   \ifdefined\scaFitTab\else\input{figures/snippets/main_tables/tabstyle.tex}\fi
\providecolor{scaRowTint}{HTML}{EAF4F1}% our rows: pale tint of the method green (scafig.SCA #13865F)
\providecolor{scaCtx}{HTML}{6E7781}% intervals and context text
\providecommand{\scaRowOurs}{\rowcolor{scaRowTint}}
% campaign mean on shared nodes, where a method has no clean time; hangs right so digits stay aligned
\providecommand{\camp}{\rlap{$^\ddagger$}}
% \scaCI{lo}{hi}: a 95% interval in grey after its estimate, at the cell's size
\providecommand{\scaCI}[2]{{\color{scaCtx}\,[#1,\,#2]}}
% \scaFitTab{colspec}{columns}{rows}: a booktabs tabular as wide as \linewidth, made by spreading the spare
% width evenly over the 2 x columns cell paddings (tabcolsep kept between 2 and 9 pt). Column specs carry no
% @{} so that shaded rows end where the rules end; unlike tabular*, shaded rows stay seamless. The rows are
% set twice: once to measure, once to print.
\providecommand{\scaFitTab}[3]{\begingroup\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0pt}%
  \sbox0{\begin{tabular}{#1}#3\end{tabular}}%
  \setlength{\tabcolsep}{\dimexpr(\linewidth-\wd0)/\numexpr2*#2\relax\relax}%
  \ifdim\tabcolsep<2pt\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}\fi\ifdim\tabcolsep>9pt\setlength{\tabcolsep}{9pt}\fi
  \begin{tabular}{#1}#3\end{tabular}\endgroup}
